introHtml: Showdown seat covers combine heavy-duty fabric with full-color dye-sublimation printing, giving your booth a polished, professional look. Whether you need flat 3-sided covers for 6- or 8-foot tables or economy throws with front-panel graphics, these covers resist wrinkles and hold up to repeated use. Perfect for trade shows, conferences, and recruiting events where first impressions matter.
